newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares set record fall on political fears.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares set record fall on political fears.

text.p: Lima shares registered their biggest fall so far this year as investor fears over internal political instability combined with profit-taking, brokers said.

Analysts predicted market volatility until the political turmoil subsided. The withdrawal of Peruvian citizenship from Israeli-born T.V. channel owner Baruch Ivcher and allegations of secret service phone-tapping have stoked market fears.
According to preliminary figures, the Lima bolsa's general index slid 5.64 percent to 2,227.29 points, as the blue-chip index fell 5.64 percent to 3,211.29 points.
